headline: China Carbon Emissions Drop 3.1% in Q3 on Lower Crude Oil Demand
summary: China's carbon dioxide emissions fell 3.1% in the third quarter following a 4% decline in crude oil consumption and lower fuel use across the industrial sector.
why: China is the world's largest crude oil importer and top carbon emitter, making its industrial activity a central indicator for global energy demand.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Crude oil demand in China dropped 4% during the third quarter as industrial sector fuel consumption declined.
